tieu_de: Sr Backend Engineer Blockchain, Crypto Exchange
dia_chi_raw: 5A, đường số 5, khu phố 4, phường An Khánh, Hồ Chí Minh
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Own a core exchange module end to end: design, code, tests, deployment, and its behaviour in production.
Build wallet infrastructure and on-chain deposit/withdrawal flows — idempotent retries, network failure handling, safe recovery, and balance reconciliation.
Bring the design, estimates, dependencies and technical risks for your module into the shared roadmap, and drive build-vs-integrate evaluations for third-party services, SDKs and node infrastructure in your area.
Settle REST and WebSocket contracts with frontend, including real-time market data.
Ship to production standards: automated tests, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, audit logs, access control. Anything touching real assets is reviewed before release.
Take operational ownership of what you build: lead triage on incidents in your modules, run the post-mortem, and land the fix that prevents the repeat.
yeu_cau:
5+ years backend engineering, including production ownership of at least one system that moves real money or real assets — exchange ledger, custody/wallet, payment settlement, trading backend, or equivalent. We want to hear what you personally built and ran.
Correctness under concurrency: database transactions, idempotency, monetary precision and rounding, reconciliation, and clean recovery from partial failure.
Strong in Go, Java or Rust — or deep Node.js/TypeScript experience with proven handling of concurrency and load. Plus SQL, Redis, a message queue, and WebSocket.
Production operations experience: you have deployed it, monitored it, and diagnosed it under pressure.
Solid grasp of access control, separation of duties, secure credential storage, and transaction signing.
Reads English technical documentation; explains architecture, risk and progress clearly.
Nice to have
Direct experience inside a live CEX — order matching, ledger, or wallet — at any scale.
Hot/cold wallet architecture or institutional custody integration.
TON / Jetton, or Telegram Mini App (TMA) development.
Liquidity provider or market maker integrations.
Load testing, disaster recovery drills, or security audit participation.
